subject: Ops handshake: security architecture deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@novacare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Ops handshake: security architecture deep-dive scheduling

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Per our notes, NovaCare requested a short technical deep-dive to cover the security & compliance architecture we use for SOC 2 customers (focus areas: evidence mapping, KMS/encryption model, audit logs, and SSO integration). We’d like to align on a 60–75 minute session with your security and infra leads so we can: 

- Walk through the artifact matrix and who on your side owns each item
- Show the KMS envelope model and key lifecycle (customer vs. platform options)
- Review audit log retention, log access controls, and how to export for audits
- Validate SSO flow (IdP provisioning and SCIM limits) and any vanity claims

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:15 or
- Wed Aug 11, 14:00–15:15

I’ve attached an initial SOC2_Artifact_Matrix.xlsx with the items we typically request from customers and the suggested owners. Can you confirm who will join from NovaCare (security lead + infra?) and which slot works best? If neither, propose two alternatives and we’ll try to accommodate.

Attachments: [SOC2_Artifact_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks — happy to tighten the agenda if you have specific concerns.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodai.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@novacare.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@novacare.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ops handshake: security architecture deep-dive scheduling

Thanks Sergio — appreciate the clear agenda and the artifact matrix. Alex (CC) will be our infrastructure lead; I’ll loop in our security architect if needed but want to confirm availability first.

Neither proposed window works for Alex (back-to-back with infra migrations). Can we do either:
- Thu Aug 12, 09:00–10:15 PDT, or
- Thu Aug 12, 15:00–16:15 PDT

Two quick questions before we lock in: 
1) For KMS, are you able to share whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys in our AWS account (we have a narrow key policy) or if it’s currently limited to Redwood-managed KMS with an envelope layer?
2) For audit logs, are logs available via streaming to our S3 (for long-term retention) or only via exports? We have a 7-year retention requirement for specific audit trails.

Also, can you confirm who will run the demo portion (architecture vs. live workload)? We’d like to set expectations for the technical level.

Elena Novak
Sr. IT Engineering Manager
NovaCare Health
elena.novak@novacare.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@novacare.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodai.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ops handshake: security architecture deep-dive scheduling

On Mon, Aug 10, 2026 at 08:47 AM Elena Novak <elena.novak@novacare.com> wrote:
> Neither proposed window works for Alex... Can we do Thu Aug 12, 09:00–10:15 PDT, or Thu Aug 12, 15:00–16:15 PDT

Thanks Elena — Monica from Redwood here, I’ll be leading the architecture walkthrough and the demo of the private-networked deployment patterns. We can absolutely cover the KMS options: 

- Customer-managed keys: supported for Private deployments and VPC options via KMIP/HSM integrations; for Hosted we provide envelope encryption with Redwood-managed KMS by default but can support BYOK for Dedicated contracts (we’ll show the flow and the required IAM roles).
- Audit logs: we support streaming audit logs to customer-owned S3 buckets for long-term retention + one-click export. We’ll show the retention controls and an example export to S3 during the session.

Thu Aug 12 at 09:00–10:15 PDT works for our team — I’ll pencil that in and share the meeting invite. Pre-reads: the attached Encrypted_Transport_Design.pdf and the SOC2_Artifact_Matrix.xlsx (Sergio shared) — please mark any items you can pre-fill.

Attachments: [Encrypted_Transport_Design.pdf (PDF), SOC2_Artifact_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Agenda (final):
- 5m intros & scope
- 20m architecture overview (KMS, envelope model, key rotation)
- 20m audit logs & retention (streaming to S3, access controls, export)
- 20m SSO/SCIM and Q&A + next steps (artifact owners, evidence handoff)

Naomi (cc) will handle the calendar invite and include the Drive link to the artifact tracker.

Thanks — Monica Patel
Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodai.com
From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@novacare.com>

Subject: Re: Ops handshake: security architecture deep-dive scheduling

Perfect — Thu Aug 12, 09:00–10:15 PDT confirmed. I’ll invite our security architect if schedules allow; otherwise Alex will attend.

Quick note: I uploaded our internal evidence baseline to the Drive link you shared and added comments next to a few items in the SOC2_Artifact_Matrix.xlsx. Please take a look before the session; I flagged the encryption key ownership rows.

See you Thursday — please send the calendar invite to elena.novak@novacare.com and alex.rodriguez@novacare.com.

Elena
